name: 平均断面法土方量计算器

map.由两端断面面积与间距求土方量: Earthwork Volume from End Areas and Spacing
map.输入两端断面面积 A₁、A₂ 与间距 L，求体积。: Enter the two end section areas A₁, A₂ and spacing L to obtain the volume.
map.📖 查看「由两端断面面积与间距求土方量 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Earthwork Volume from End Areas and Spacing User Guide"
map.相邻断面取平均乘间距。: Average adjacent sections and multiply by spacing.
map.两断面面积平均乘间距。: Average the two section areas and multiply by spacing.
map.全线按桩号断面两两相邻算再求和，得总挖/填方。: Compute adjacent station sections along the whole line pairwise then sum to get total cut / fill.
map.和棱镜体区别？: How does it differ from prismoidal?
map.平均断面=(A₁+A₂)/2×L；棱镜体=L/6(A₁+4Am+A₂) 更准（含: Average end-area = (A₁+A₂)/2×L; prismoidal = L/6(A₁+4Am+A₂) is more accurate (includes mid section); equal under linear change.
map.间距应相等或逐段用对应 L，混距直接套会错。: Spacing should be equal or use the matching L per segment; mixing distances in one formula is wrong.
